about_the_game:
Get ready for a midnight frenzy with eccentric weapon spray paints and unique character outfits!

This expansion includes weapon customization spray paints and special-appearance gears.

Pack Includes:

  • Spray Paints:

    • Spooky (1 pcs.)

    • Carved Scars (1 pcs.)

  • Gears:

    • Riveted Face Mask (1 pcs.)

    • RYS-T FaceShield 'Haunted' (1 pcs.)

    • RYS-T Helmet 'Haunted' (1 pcs.)

    • IOTV Gen3 'Haunted' (1 pcs.)

    • Mag Pouch M 'Haunted' (2 pcs.)

    • Mag Pouch S 'Haunted' (4 pcs.)

    • G.N.J.Backpack 'Haunted' (1 pcs.)

  • Merchant Store(s)

    • Unlocks 'Spooky' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Carved Scars' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Mag Pouch M 'Haunted''

    • Unlocks 'Mag Pouch S 'Haunted''

    • Unlocks 'Riveted Face Mask' (Additional condition: Maximilian's Trust LV. 2)

    • Unlocks 'RYS-T FaceShield 'Haunted'' (Additional condition: Maximilian's Trust LV. 3)

    • Unlocks 'RYS-T Helmet 'Haunted'' (Additional condition: Maximilian's Trust LV. 3)

    • Unlocks 'IOTV Gen3 'Haunted'' (Additional condition: Maximilian's Trust LV. 3)

    • Unlocks 'G.N.J.Backpack 'Haunted'' (Additional condition: Maximilian's Trust LV. 3)

Spray paints can be applied to weapons at the Spray Painting Booth in the Hideout.

Items included in this DLC will be sent via in-game mails. Please check your mailbox after purchase to claim your items.

Some DLC items require additional in-game conditions to unlock merchant store purchase access.

DLC contents will be reissued after each data reset, its actual content is subject to change in future updates.
